title: Q-STD-config: Add per-file JSON Schemas to drained configs
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/open-standards.json::"id": "config-json-schema".*"status": "adopted"
**Status:** open

OPEN-STANDARDS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): the daily openstd workflow adds the base $schema to baseline configs; replace the base schema with a strict per-file schema for the ten most-read configs, validated by the check.

size: M
Out of scope: new formats not in doctrine/open-standards.json.

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation openstd --check passes and the registry row for config-json-schema reads adopted with evidence files that exist.
